description:
Thoughtful storage meets timeless design with the West Lake 3 Drawer Nightstand. Three dovetailed drawers with smooth glides provide convenient storage for nursery essentials, pacifiers, lotions, books, and more.

The solid hardwood construction and warm Brown Maple finish match the full West Lake collection. Compact enough to fit beside a glider or crib, this nightstand is as practical as it is beautiful. Non-toxic baby-safe finish.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
